user.title: Set Up UniFi Network Infrastructure
user.description:
Start by entering the local UniFi controller host and the dedicated service account Home Assistant should use.

This integration imports UniFi routers, switches, and access points only. It does not create client trackers or add ordinary network clients as devices.

controller_settings.name: UniFi Controller
controller_settings.description: Use a local UniFi OS or UniFi Network account created for this integration. Avoid personal cloud accounts.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address for the local UniFi controller. Do not include a path or site name.
data_description.username: Dedicated local UniFi account username for this integration.
data_description.password: Password for the dedicated local UniFi account.
data_description.port: HTTPS port for the controller. Most local UniFi OS consoles use 443.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only when using a local certificate Home Assistant cannot validate.

control_options.title: Choose UniFi Entities And Controls
control_options.description:
Choose the monitoring and control families Home Assistant should create.

Detected permission mode: {permission_mode}. Read-only UniFi accounts can still add monitoring entities, but write-control options are shown as read-only for awareness.

monitoring_settings.name: Monitoring
monitoring_settings.description: How often Home Assistant refreshes infrastructure state from UniFi.

data_description.scan_interval: Polling interval in seconds. Lower values update faster but increase controller API traffic.

protection_settings.name: Protection
protection_settings.description: Create safety locks for ports that should not be changed accidentally.

data_description.enable_port_protection: Prevent Home Assistant from making port configuration changes unless the port is unlocked. Internet-facing, uplink, downlink, access point, and other network-device ports are locked automatically.

wifi_controls.name: Wi-Fi Controls
wifi_controls.description: Expose Wi-Fi SSID enable and disable switches. If the account is read-only, these options are shown for awareness only and cannot be selected. Wired guest networks are not controlled here.

data_description.enable_wifi_controls: Create switches for normal UniFi Wi-Fi SSIDs so Home Assistant can enable or disable wireless networks.
data_description.enable_guest_wifi_controls: Create switches for SSIDs UniFi marks as guest Wi-Fi. This does not control wired guest VLANs.

port_controls.name: Port Controls
port_controls.description: Expose controls that can change switch and router port state. If the account is read-only, these options are shown for awareness only and cannot be selected. Protected ports must be unlocked first.

data_description.enable_interface_controls: Allow Home Assistant to create per-port control entities. The options below decide which port controls are exposed.
data_description.enable_port_admin_controls: Create switches that administratively enable or disable individual ports. Protected ports must be unlocked first.
data_description.enable_port_bounce: Create buttons that briefly disable and re-enable a port. Useful for recovering a link without changing other settings.
data_description.enable_poe_controls: Create switches that enable or disable power delivery on PoE-capable ports without changing the port admin state. Protected ports must be unlocked first.
data_description.enable_poe_reset: Create buttons that briefly cycle PoE power on capable ports without intentionally disabling the data port. Useful for restarting a powered device while preserving port configuration.

router_policy_controls.name: Router Policy Controls
router_policy_controls.description: These controls can change routing or exposure through the UniFi gateway. If the account is read-only, these options are shown for awareness only and cannot be selected. No entities are created unless the relevant option is enabled. Created entities are disabled by default and must be enabled individually in Home Assistant before use.

data_description.enable_port_forward_controls: Create disabled-by-default configuration switches for user-editable UniFi port forwarding rules.
data_description.enable_route_policy_controls: Create disabled-by-default configuration switches for UniFi traffic routes and policy-based routes.
data_description.enable_firewall_policy_controls: Create disabled-by-default configuration switches for user-editable firewall policies. Generated, fixed, and IPS deny-list policies are excluded.

device_maintenance_controls.name: Device Maintenance
device_maintenance_controls.description: Optional diagnostic controls for actions that affect UniFi hardware directly. If the account is read-only, these options are shown for awareness only and cannot be selected.

data_description.enable_locate_control: Create diagnostic buttons that trigger UniFi locate or identify actions on supported devices.
data_description.enable_reboot_control: Create reboot buttons protected by a confirmation selector. Reboot actions remain disabled until confirmation is armed.

error.cannot_connect: Could Not Connect To UniFi Network.

abort.already_configured: This UniFi Site Is Already Configured.
